sources.title: Trl Internal Testing Tiny…: 1GB VRAM (Q4) — Best GPUs
sources.snippet: Quick answer: Trl Internal Testing Tiny Qwen2forcausallm 2.5 needs roughly 1 GB VRAM for Q4_K_M and 1 GB for Q5_K_M. Use Q8 (1 GB) or FP16 (1 GB) for higher quality output. Full-model (FP16) requirements are shown by default. Quantized builds like Q4 trade accuracy for lower VRAM usage. Ready to buy?
